// Mug — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

// Re-run tools/safe-edit/bin/_build-dungeon-animations.js to regenerate.

(async () => {

const CFG = {"move":"mug","casterFoot":0.95,"partyFoot":0.97,"seed":2525,"volume":0.75,"totalTimeoutMs":15000,"coins":2};

const ASSETS = {"clips":{"hit_phys":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/RPG%20Maker%20MV/001_hit_physical.webm","w":488,"h":488,"dur":333,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.5,"k":0.55,"add":false}},"sfx":{"swingA":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_SWINGA.wav","slash1":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Slash1.ogg","steal":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Steal.ogg","coin":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Coin.ogg"},"images":{}};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.legacy-jill-mug";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Mug]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Zero Power kit (prepended after the party _kit by zp-signatures.js) ──────

// Shared pieces of the four party Zero Powers (2026-11-06 overhaul, mockup v17):

// the shipped full-body cut-in, hit cues, the cast focus fade, the game's flinch

// for painted copies, screen anchors for numbers, and small particle helpers.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const ZP = {};

// Fire something ONCE when the timeline reaches 'at' (tracks run per frame while

// t0 <= t < t1, so a 1 ms window can be skipped; this one stays open).

ZP.once = (m, at, fn) => { let done = false; m.hold(at, 1e9, () => { if (done) return; done = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[ZP] once threw', e); } }); };

// A Chain tick: reveals the next strike (number, HP bar, counter) on the acting GM.

// info: { numbersOnly, screenAt: { [tokenUuid]: { fx, fy } } } or a function returning it.

// paced: every Zero Power cues each strike itself, so the presenter never fills a gap with its own beat.

ZP.hit = (m, at, info) => ZP.once(m, at, () => oni.hit(Object.assign({ paced: true }, typeof info === 'function' ? info() : (info || {}))));

// The shipped Zero Power cut-in (createCutinDOM/runCutinDOM): a full-body image

// 92% of the view tall on the bottom edge; left -120% -> 0 (CSS ease-out, 650 ms),

// hold 850 ms, -> 120% (CSS ease-in, 650 ms). Drawn in screen space above the board.

// Needs A.images[key]; Overdrive is a cfg sfx cue at the same time.

ZP.cssOut = (t) => ZP.bez(0, 0, 0.58, 1, t);

ZP.cssIn = (t) => ZP.bez(0.42, 0, 1, 1, t);

ZP.bez = (x1, y1, x2, y2, x) => { let t = x; for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const cx = 3 * x1, bx = 3 * (x2 - x1) - cx, ax = 1 - cx - bx; const fx = ((ax * t + bx) * t + cx) * t - x; const d = (3 * ax * t + 2 * bx) * t + cx; if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-6) break; t -= fx / d; } const cy = 3 * y1, by = 3 * (y2 - y1) - cy, ay = 1 - cy - by; return ((ay * t + by) * t + cy) * t; };

ZP.cutin = (tl, m, at, key, o) => {

o = o || {}; const inMs = o.slideIn || 650, hold = o.hold || 850, outMs = o.slideOut || 650; const end = inMs + hold + outMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => { const img = tl.IMG[key]; if (!img) return; (o.over ? S.over : S.screen).push({ draw: (g) => {

const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = g.H * 0.92, w = h * iw / ih;

const x = e < inMs ? -1.2 * g.W * (1 - ZP.cssOut(e / inMs)) : e < inMs + hold ? 0 : 1.2 * g.W * ZP.cssIn((e - inMs - hold) / outMs);

g.save(); g.globalAlpha = 1; g.drawImage(img, x, g.H - h, w, h); g.restore(); } }); });

return at + end;

};

// Everyone on the board who is not the caster or a target, as extra timeline tokens

// ('b0', 'b1', ...), so the cast focus can fade them. Summon tokens already on the

// field are bystanders too (the user's dedupe rule: the parade never shows a real

// Crysta next to the drawn one). keep: extra tokens to leave alone.

ZP.bystanders = (keep) => {

const out = {}; const skip = new Set(); if (caster) skip.add(caster.id); for (const t of targets) skip.add(t.id); for (const t of (keep || [])) if (t) skip.add(t.id);

let n = 0; for (const t of (canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []) { if (skip.has(t.id) || !t.visible || !t.mesh || (t.document && t.document.hidden)) continue; out['b' + (n++)] = { token: t }; }

return out;

};

// Fade the bystanders out from 'at' over ms, keep them out until 'back', fade back over backMs.

ZP.focus = (m, TOK, at, ms, back, backMs) => {

const keys = Object.keys(TOK).filter((k) => k.charAt(0) === 'b' && /^b[0-9]+$/.test(k));

for (const k of keys) m.hold(at, back + backMs, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; const t = e + at; let a; if (t < at + ms) a = 1 - (t - at) / ms; else if (t < back) a = 0; else a = Math.min(1, (t - back) / backMs); if (a < 1) { if (a <= 0.001) q.hidden = true; else q.alpha *= a; } });

return keys;

};

// The game's FULL_FLINCH (battler-pose.js): [time, scaleX, scaleY, shiftX px] and brightness.

ZP.FLINCH = {

normal: { ms: 300, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.12, 1.12, 0.88, 0], [0.30, 0.97, 1.03, -7], [0.50, 1, 1, 6], [0.70, 1, 1, -4], [0.85, 1, 1, 3], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 3.6], [0.35, 1], [1, 1]] },

strong: { ms: 480, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.10, 1.22, 0.80, 0], [0.26, 0.90, 1.10, -13], [0.44, 1, 1, 11], [0.62, 1, 1, -7], [0.80, 1, 1, 5], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 4], [0.20, 1], [0.40, 3.2], [0.60, 1], [1, 1]] },

};

ZP.stop = (stops, t, col) => { for (let i = 1; i < stops.length; i++) if (t <= stops[i][0]) { const a = stops[i - 1], b = stops[i]; const u = (t - a[0]) / Math.max(1e-6, b[0] - a[0]); const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u); return a[col] + (b[col] - a[col]) * k; } return stops[stops.length - 1][col]; };

// Flinch sample at ms since the hit: { sx, sy, dx, b (brightness) } or null when over.

ZP.flinchAt = (ms, tier) => { const F = ZP.FLINCH[tier || 'normal']; if (ms < 0 || ms >= F.ms) return null; const u = ms / F.ms; return { sx: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 1), sy: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 2), dx: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 3), b: ZP.stop(F.bright, u, 1) }; };

// The hurt reaction on a PAINTED timeline token k at 'at': its hurt art (sprite_hurt,

// the engine's hurt loop) for hurtMs with the flinch on top, else the flinch alone.

// Use with oni.hit({ numbersOnly: true }) so the game's own DOM flinch stays off.

ZP.flinchTok = (m, at, k, tier, hurtMs) => {

const F = ZP.FLINCH[tier || 'normal']; const hold = Math.max(F.ms, hurtMs == null ? 700 : hurtMs);

m.hold(at, at + hold, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; q.hurt = true; const f = ZP.flinchAt(e, tier); if (!f) return; q.sx *= f.sx; q.sy *= f.sy; q.dx += f.dx; if (f.b > 1.05) { const a = Math.min(1, (f.b - 1) / 3); if (a > q.tintA) { q.tint = '#ffffff'; q.tintA = a; } } });

};

// Screen anchor for a damage number at screen px (x, y) of the overlay: board-view fractions.

ZP.frac = (g, x, y) => ({ fx: x / g.W, fy: y / g.H });

// Splitting for a drawn pseudo multi-hit preview (bench only; in battle the numbers come from BD).

ZP.split = (total, n) => { const out = []; let prev = 0; for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) { const c = Math.round(total * i / n); out.push(c - prev); prev = c; } return out; };

// A soft additive glow (canvas 2D).

ZP.glow = (g, x, y, r, rgb, a) => { if (!(r > 0) || !(a > 0)) return; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); };

// A deterministic particle field for a track: n particles from seed, each p(i, r) => spec,

// drawn by draw(g, p, e). Lets a whole ember/dust swarm live in one track (no per-frame spawns).

ZP.swarm = (tl, n, seed, make) => { const r = tl.rng(seed || 3); const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push(make(i, r)); return out; };

// A glow-sprite with a black backing turned into real alpha (alpha = brightness), cached.

ZP._ga = new Map();

ZP.glowAlpha = (img) => { if (!img) return null; if (ZP._ga.has(img)) return ZP._ga.get(img); const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width, h = img.naturalHeight || img.height; if (!w || !h) return null; const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = w; cv.height = h; const x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0);

try { const id = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h), d = id.data; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) { const mx = Math.max(d[i], d[i + 1], d[i + 2]); if (mx > 0) { d[i] = d[i] * 255 / mx; d[i + 1] = d[i + 1] * 255 / mx; d[i + 2] = d[i + 2] * 255 / mx; } d[i + 3] = mx; } x.putImageData(id, 0, 0); } catch (e) { return img; }

ZP._ga.set(img, cv); return cv; };

// Tip and joint of a Disgaea weapon part, read from its alpha (top-most / bottom-most opaque rows).

ZP._li = new Map();

ZP.limbInfo = (img) => { if (ZP._li.has(img)) return ZP._li.get(img); const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width, h = img.naturalHeight || img.height; const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = w; cv.height = h; const x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0); let d; try { d = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data; } catch (e) { const r0 = { tip: { x: w / 2, y: 0 }, joint: { x: w / 2, y: h } }; ZP._li.set(img, r0); return r0; }

const row = (y) => { let a = -1, b = -1; for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) if (d[(y * w + i) * 4 + 3] > 90) { if (a < 0) a = i; b = i; } return a < 0 ? null : (a + b) / 2; };

let tip = null, joint = null; for (let y = 0; y < h && !tip; y++) { const c = row(y); if (c != null) tip = { x: c, y }; } for (let y = h - 1; y >= 0 && !joint; y--) { const c = row(y); if (c != null) joint = { x: c, y }; }

const r = { tip: tip || { x: w / 2, y: 0 }, joint: joint || { x: w / 2, y: h } }; ZP._li.set(img, r); return r; };

// ── Legacy twins kit (Jack + Jill, + the shared Mug / Cleaving Strike Rauben also uses) ──────────────

// Prepended (after the Zero Power kit) by legacy-twins-signatures.js. A canvas-2D port of the mockup's

// shared kit ("Legacy boss animations" mockup, part-common.js + the round-3 afterimage / comic puff):

// a keyframed body for the caster, afterimage ghosts, a stepped particle field (ground / field / hit

// layers), projectiles with glow trails, rings, cracks, dust, twinkles, wisps, coins, the impact frame,

// radial speed lines and the pixel-crisp Zero Power cut-in.

// LIVE board: the camera is never touched; only bodies a beat moves are painted. Every mockup number is

// in mockup px on a 1682 px stage and is scaled by KP (stage width / 1682) and the depth ratio.

// Mirroring: the mockup's enemy faces right; every x offset and rotation is multiplied by DIR.

// No backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && t !== caster);

if (!caster) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const tokens = { k: { token: caster, foot: cfg.casterFoot } };

const FOES = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; FOES.push(k); tokens[k] = { token: t, foot: cfg.partyFoot }; });

const CL = A.clips || {};

// cfg.live false = FULL TAKEOVER (the shot owns the board and drives S.cam: Apex Arrow's push-in); else LIVE board

const LIVE = cfg.live !== false;

const tl = oni.timeline(LIVE ? { tokens, clips: CL, images: A.images || {}, live: true, depthRef: 'k' } : { tokens, clips: CL, images: A.images || {} });

await tl.load();

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp, TOK = tl.TOK, feet = tl.feet;

const KP = (tl.STAGE.w || 1682) / 1682;

const R = tl.rng(cfg.seed || 2525);

const rnd = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * R();

const T = [], sfx = [];

const m = tl.mk(T);

const once = (at, fn) => { let did = false; T.push({ t0: at, t1: 1e9, fn: () => { if (!did) { did = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[ONI][twins] cue threw', e); } } } }); };

const S_ = (at, url, v) => { if (url) sfx.push({ at: Math.round(at), url, v: v * (cfg.volume == null ? 0.75 : cfg.volume) }); };

const SX = (at, key, v) => S_(at, (A.sfx || {})[key], v);

const DEG = Math.PI / 180;

const K = TOK.k, KF = feet(K);

// facing: toward the first target; with none (a self-cast) the way the caster's art faces

const DIR = FOES.length ? (TOK[FOES[0]].x >= K.x ? 1 : -1) : (K.dir || 1);

const DR = (pt) => tl.depthRatio(KF, pt); // size at pt vs the caster's spot

const HB = (k) => TOK[k].h * TOK[k].foot; // body height above the feet

const tFeet = (k) => feet(TOK[k]);

const tCenter = (k) => { const f = feet(TOK[k]); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - HB(k) * 0.5 }; };

// a spot in front of a target, on the caster's side (the mockup's front(t, gap))

const front = (k, gap) => { const f = tFeet(k); return { x: f.x - DIR * gap * KP * DR(f), y: f.y }; };

// EASE names as the mockup has them

const EZ = { lin: E.lin, quad: E.ioQ, out: E.outQ, in: E.inQ, outCubic: E.outC, sine: E.sine };

const EOUTBACK = (u) => { const c1 = 1.70158, c3 = c1 + 1; return 1 + c3 * Math.pow(u - 1, 3) + c1 * Math.pow(u - 1, 2); };

// ── the caster's body: keyframed channels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

// dx / dy (scene px), lift (scene px), rot (deg, the mockup's enemy sign), sx / sy, hop (an arc on top

// of the lift), pivot (0 = feet, 1 = the mockup's 50% 55% spin pivot).

const chan = (v0) => ({ v0, segs: [] });

const valAt = (c, t) => { let v = c.v0; for (const s of c.segs) { if (t < s.t0) break; const u = s.t1 > s.t0 ? Math.min(1, (t - s.t0) / (s.t1 - s.t0)) : 1; v = s.fn ? (t >= s.t1 ? s.fn(1) : s.fn(u)) : (t >= s.t1 ? s.to : lerp(s.from, s.to, s.ease(u))); } return v; };

const key = (c, at, ms, to, ease) => { const from = valAt(c, at); c.segs.push({ t0: at, t1: at + Math.max(0, ms), from, to, ease: ease || E.lin }); c.segs.sort((a, b) => a.t0 - b.t0); };

const keyFn = (c, at, ms, fn) => { c.segs.push({ t0: at, t1: at + Math.max(1, ms), fn }); c.segs.sort((a, b) => a.t0 - b.t0); };

const BODY = { dx: chan(0), dy: chan(0), lift: chan(0), hop: chan(0), rot: chan(0), sx: chan(1), sy: chan(1), pivot: chan(0) };

let BODY_END = 0;

// pose at t: what the engine draws, plus the un-pivoted lift (anchor points use that, as the mockup does)

function pose(t) {

const dx = valAt(BODY.dx, t), dy = valAt(BODY.dy, t), lift = valAt(BODY.lift, t) + valAt(BODY.hop, t);

const rot = valAt(BODY.rot, t) * DIR * DEG, sx = valAt(BODY.sx, t), sy = valAt(BODY.sy, t);

let air = lift, ddx = dx;

if (valAt(BODY.pivot, t) >= 0.5 && rot) { const r = (dx || dy) ? tl.depthRatio(KF, { x: KF.x + dx, y: KF.y + dy }) : 1; const ph = K.h * (K.foot - 0.55) * r * sy; ddx -= ph * Math.sin(rot); air += ph * (1 - Math.cos(rot)); }

return { dx: ddx, dy, air, rot, sx, sy, lift, bx: dx };

}

// moves (mockup: moveActor / goHome / lean / squash / liftTo / spin)

const moveTo = (at, ms, pt, ease, o) => { o = o || {}; key(BODY.dx, at, ms, pt.x - KF.x, ease || EZ.sine); key(BODY.dy, at, ms, pt.y - KF.y, ease || EZ.sine); if (o.hop) { const h = o.hop * KP; keyFn(BODY.hop, at, ms, (u) => Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * h); } if (o.trail) for (const f of [0.31, 0.62, 0.93]) ghostAt(at + ms * f, o.ghost || {}); return at + ms; };

const goHome = (at, ms, o) => moveTo(at, ms, KF, EZ.quad, o);

const lean = (at, ms, deg, ease) => { key(BODY.rot, at, ms, deg, ease || EZ.out); return at + ms; };

const squash = (at, ms, sx, sy, ease) => { key(BODY.sx, at, ms, sx, ease || EZ.out); key(BODY.sy, at, ms, sy, ease || EZ.out); return at + ms; };

const liftTo = (at, ms, h, ease) => { key(BODY.lift, at, ms, h * KP, ease || EZ.outCubic); return at + ms; };

const pivot = (at, mid) => key(BODY.pivot, at, 0, mid ? 1 : 0);

// anchor points on the caster (mockup hand(a) / bodyAt(a) / feet(a)), at time t

const casterPt = (t, u, v) => { const p = pose(t), r = (p.bx || p.dy) ? tl.depthRatio(KF, { x: KF.x + p.bx, y: KF.y + p.dy }) : 1; return { x: KF.x + p.bx + DIR * K.w * u * r, y: KF.y + p.dy - p.lift - HB('k') * v * r }; };

const hand = (t) => casterPt(t, 0.3, 0.62);

const bodyAt = (t) => casterPt(t, 0, 0.5);

const cFeet = (t) => casterPt(t, 0, 0);

const headAt = (t) => casterPt(t, 0, 0.95);

// ── art copies: afterimage ghosts, scaling copies, a glow ring behind the body ──────────────

const ART = tl.art('k');

const bake = (filter, pad) => { if (!ART) return null; const w = ART.naturalWidth || ART.videoWidth || ART.width, h = ART.naturalHeight || ART.videoHeight || ART.height; if (!w || !h) return null; pad = pad || 0;

const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w + pad * 2; c.height = h + pad * 2; const x = c.getContext('2d'); try { x.filter = filter || 'none'; x.drawImage(ART, pad, pad, w, h); } catch (e) { return null; } return { cv: c, pad, w, h }; };

const GHOST = {};

const ghostImg = (o) => { const f = o.filter || (o.hue == null ? 'brightness(1.6) saturate(.4)' : 'sepia(1) saturate(5) hue-rotate(' + (o.hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(1.35)'); if (!(f in GHOST)) GHOST[f] = bake(f, 0); return GHOST[f]; };

// draw a copy of the caster's art at pose p (es = extra scale about the feet)

function drawCopy(g, B, p, alpha, es) {

if (!B || alpha <= 0) return; es = es || 1;

const r = (p.dx || p.dy) ? tl.depthRatio(KF, { x: KF.x + p.dx, y: KF.y + p.dy }) : 1;

const padW = B.pad * K.w / B.w, padH = B.pad * K.h / B.h;

g.save(); g.translate(K.x + p.dx, KF.y + p.dy - p.air); if (p.rot) g.rotate(p.rot); g.scale(K.flip * p.sx * r * es, p.sy * r * es); g.globalAlpha = alpha;

g.drawImage(B.cv, -K.w / 2 - padW, -K.h * K.foot - padH, K.w + padW * 2, K.h + padH * 2); g.restore();

}

// one ghost spawned at 'at' showing the pose of that moment, fading over o.ms (mockup afterimage)

const GHOSTS = [];

function ghostAt(at, o) { o = o || {}; GHOSTS.push({ at, ms: o.ms || 380, op: o.opacity == null ? 0.5 : o.opacity, img: ghostImg(o) }); }

// ghosts every 'every' ms from 'from' to 'to' (mockup trailWhile)

function trail(from, to, every, o) { for (let t = from; t < to; t += every) ghostAt(t, o); }

m.hold(0, 1e9, (t, S) => { if (!GHOSTS.length) return; S.world.push({ z: 4, draw: (g) => { for (const q of GHOSTS) { const age = t - q.at; if (age < 0 || age > q.ms) continue; drawCopy(g, q.img, pose(q.at), q.op * (1 - age / q.ms)); } } }); });

// ── the stepped particle field (mockup addP / frame): positions scene px, velocities mockup px/ms ──

// layers: ground (under the battlers), field (over them), hit (over everything on the board)

const PL = { ground: [], field: [], hit: [] };

const LZ = { ground: 2, field: 24, hit: 46 };

const addP = (layer, p) => { PL[layer].push(Object.assign({ t: 0, life: 1000, vx: 0, vy: 0, g: 0, drag: 1 }, p)); };

const spawn = (at, fn) => once(at, fn);

let lastT = null;

m.hold(0, 1e9, (t, S) => {

const C = coinsTo(H, tCenter(TK), bodyAt(H), n, 520);

// Cleaving Strike: steps up to the party, one wide sweep, a hit cue on each target as it passes

const order = FOES.slice().sort((a, b) => tFeet(a).y - tFeet(b).y);

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Zero Power kit (prepended after the party _kit by zp-signatures.js) ──────

// Shared pieces of the four party Zero Powers (2026-11-06 overhaul, mockup v17):

// the shipped full-body cut-in, hit cues, the cast focus fade, the game's flinch

// for painted copies, screen anchors for numbers, and small particle helpers.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const ZP = {};

// Fire something ONCE when the timeline reaches 'at' (tracks run per frame while

// t0 <= t < t1, so a 1 ms window can be skipped; this one stays open).

ZP.once = (m, at, fn) => { let done = false; m.hold(at, 1e9, () => { if (done) return; done = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[ZP] once threw', e); } }); };

// A Chain tick: reveals the next strike (number, HP bar, counter) on the acting GM.

// info: { numbersOnly, screenAt: { [tokenUuid]: { fx, fy } } } or a function returning it.

// paced: every Zero Power cues each strike itself, so the presenter never fills a gap with its own beat.

ZP.hit = (m, at, info) => ZP.once(m, at, () => oni.hit(Object.assign({ paced: true }, typeof info === 'function' ? info() : (info || {}))));

// The shipped Zero Power cut-in (createCutinDOM/runCutinDOM): a full-body image

// 92% of the view tall on the bottom edge; left -120% -> 0 (CSS ease-out, 650 ms),

// hold 850 ms, -> 120% (CSS ease-in, 650 ms). Drawn in screen space above the board.

// Needs A.images[key]; Overdrive is a cfg sfx cue at the same time.

ZP.cssOut = (t) => ZP.bez(0, 0, 0.58, 1, t);

ZP.cssIn = (t) => ZP.bez(0.42, 0, 1, 1, t);

ZP.bez = (x1, y1, x2, y2, x) => { let t = x; for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const cx = 3 * x1, bx = 3 * (x2 - x1) - cx, ax = 1 - cx - bx; const fx = ((ax * t + bx) * t + cx) * t - x; const d = (3 * ax * t + 2 * bx) * t + cx; if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-6) break; t -= fx / d; } const cy = 3 * y1, by = 3 * (y2 - y1) - cy, ay = 1 - cy - by; return ((ay * t + by) * t + cy) * t; };

ZP.cutin = (tl, m, at, key, o) => {

o = o || {}; const inMs = o.slideIn || 650, hold = o.hold || 850, outMs = o.slideOut || 650; const end = inMs + hold + outMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => { const img = tl.IMG[key]; if (!img) return; (o.over ? S.over : S.screen).push({ draw: (g) => {

const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = g.H * 0.92, w = h * iw / ih;

const x = e < inMs ? -1.2 * g.W * (1 - ZP.cssOut(e / inMs)) : e < inMs + hold ? 0 : 1.2 * g.W * ZP.cssIn((e - inMs - hold) / outMs);

g.save(); g.globalAlpha = 1; g.drawImage(img, x, g.H - h, w, h); g.restore(); } }); });

return at + end;

};

// Everyone on the board who is not the caster or a target, as extra timeline tokens

// ('b0', 'b1', ...), so the cast focus can fade them. Summon tokens already on the

// field are bystanders too (the user's dedupe rule: the parade never shows a real

// Crysta next to the drawn one). keep: extra tokens to leave alone.

ZP.bystanders = (keep) => {

const out = {}; const skip = new Set(); if (caster) skip.add(caster.id); for (const t of targets) skip.add(t.id); for (const t of (keep || [])) if (t) skip.add(t.id);

let n = 0; for (const t of (canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []) { if (skip.has(t.id) || !t.visible || !t.mesh || (t.document && t.document.hidden)) continue; out['b' + (n++)] = { token: t }; }

return out;

};

// Fade the bystanders out from 'at' over ms, keep them out until 'back', fade back over backMs.

ZP.focus = (m, TOK, at, ms, back, backMs) => {

const keys = Object.keys(TOK).filter((k) => k.charAt(0) === 'b' && /^b[0-9]+$/.test(k));

for (const k of keys) m.hold(at, back + backMs, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; const t = e + at; let a; if (t < at + ms) a = 1 - (t - at) / ms; else if (t < back) a = 0; else a = Math.min(1, (t - back) / backMs); if (a < 1) { if (a <= 0.001) q.hidden = true; else q.alpha *= a; } });

return keys;

};

// The game's FULL_FLINCH (battler-pose.js): [time, scaleX, scaleY, shiftX px] and brightness.

ZP.FLINCH = {

normal: { ms: 300, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.12, 1.12, 0.88, 0], [0.30, 0.97, 1.03, -7], [0.50, 1, 1, 6], [0.70, 1, 1, -4], [0.85, 1, 1, 3], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 3.6], [0.35, 1], [1, 1]] },

strong: { ms: 480, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.10, 1.22, 0.80, 0], [0.26, 0.90, 1.10, -13], [0.44, 1, 1, 11], [0.62, 1, 1, -7], [0.80, 1, 1, 5], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 4], [0.20, 1], [0.40, 3.2], [0.60, 1], [1, 1]] },

};

ZP.stop = (stops, t, col) => { for (let i = 1; i < stops.length; i++) if (t <= stops[i][0]) { const a = stops[i - 1], b = stops[i]; const u = (t - a[0]) / Math.max(1e-6, b[0] - a[0]); const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u); return a[col] + (b[col] - a[col]) * k; } return stops[stops.length - 1][col]; };

// Flinch sample at ms since the hit: { sx, sy, dx, b (brightness) } or null when over.

ZP.flinchAt = (ms, tier) => { const F = ZP.FLINCH[tier || 'normal']; if (ms < 0 || ms >= F.ms) return null; const u = ms / F.ms; return { sx: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 1), sy: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 2), dx: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 3), b: ZP.stop(F.bright, u, 1) }; };

// The hurt reaction on a PAINTED timeline token k at 'at': its hurt art (sprite_hurt,

// the engine's hurt loop) for hurtMs with the flinch on top, else the flinch alone.

// Use with oni.hit({ numbersOnly: true }) so the game's own DOM flinch stays off.

ZP.flinchTok = (m, at, k, tier, hurtMs) => {

const F = ZP.FLINCH[tier || 'normal']; const hold = Math.max(F.ms, hurtMs == null ? 700 : hurtMs);

m.hold(at, at + hold, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; q.hurt = true; const f = ZP.flinchAt(e, tier); if (!f) return; q.sx *= f.sx; q.sy *= f.sy; q.dx += f.dx; if (f.b > 1.05) { const a = Math.min(1, (f.b - 1) / 3); if (a > q.tintA) { q.tint = '#ffffff'; q.tintA = a; } } });

};

// Screen anchor for a damage number at screen px (x, y) of the overlay: board-view fractions.

ZP.frac = (g, x, y) => ({ fx: x / g.W, fy: y / g.H });

// Splitting for a drawn pseudo multi-hit preview (bench only; in battle the numbers come from BD).

ZP.split = (total, n) => { const out = []; let prev = 0; for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) { const c = Math.round(total * i / n); out.push(c - prev); prev = c; } return out; };

// A soft additive glow (canvas 2D).

ZP.glow = (g, x, y, r, rgb, a) => { if (!(r > 0) || !(a > 0)) return; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); };

// A deterministic particle field for a track: n particles from seed, each p(i, r) => spec,

// drawn by draw(g, p, e). Lets a whole ember/dust swarm live in one track (no per-frame spawns).

ZP.swarm = (tl, n, seed, make) => { const r = tl.rng(seed || 3); const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push(make(i, r)); return out; };

// A glow-sprite with a black backing turned into real alpha (alpha = brightness), cached.

ZP._ga = new Map();

ZP.glowAlpha = (img) => { if (!img) return null; if (ZP._ga.has(img)) return ZP._ga.get(img); const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width, h = img.naturalHeight || img.height; if (!w || !h) return null; const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = w; cv.height = h; const x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0);

try { const id = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h), d = id.data; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) { const mx = Math.max(d[i], d[i + 1], d[i + 2]); if (mx > 0) { d[i] = d[i] * 255 / mx; d[i + 1] = d[i + 1] * 255 / mx; d[i + 2] = d[i + 2] * 255 / mx; } d[i + 3] = mx; } x.putImageData(id, 0, 0); } catch (e) { return img; }

ZP._ga.set(img, cv); return cv; };

// Tip and joint of a Disgaea weapon part, read from its alpha (top-most / bottom-most opaque rows).

ZP._li = new Map();

ZP.limbInfo = (img) => { if (ZP._li.has(img)) return ZP._li.get(img); const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width, h = img.naturalHeight || img.height; const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = w; cv.height = h; const x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0); let d; try { d = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data; } catch (e) { const r0 = { tip: { x: w / 2, y: 0 }, joint: { x: w / 2, y: h } }; ZP._li.set(img, r0); return r0; }

const row = (y) => { let a = -1, b = -1; for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) if (d[(y * w + i) * 4 + 3] > 90) { if (a < 0) a = i; b = i; } return a < 0 ? null : (a + b) / 2; };

let tip = null, joint = null; for (let y = 0; y < h && !tip; y++) { const c = row(y); if (c != null) tip = { x: c, y }; } for (let y = h - 1; y >= 0 && !joint; y--) { const c = row(y); if (c != null) joint = { x: c, y }; }

const r = { tip: tip || { x: w / 2, y: 0 }, joint: joint || { x: w / 2, y: h } }; ZP._li.set(img, r); return r; };

// ── Legacy twins kit (Jack + Jill, + the shared Mug / Cleaving Strike Rauben also uses) ──────────────

// Prepended (after the Zero Power kit) by legacy-twins-signatures.js. A canvas-2D port of the mockup's

// shared kit ("Legacy boss animations" mockup, part-common.js + the round-3 afterimage / comic puff):

// a keyframed body for the caster, afterimage ghosts, a stepped particle field (ground / field / hit

// layers), projectiles with glow trails, rings, cracks, dust, twinkles, wisps, coins, the impact frame,

// radial speed lines and the pixel-crisp Zero Power cut-in.

// LIVE board: the camera is never touched; only bodies a beat moves are painted. Every mockup number is

// in mockup px on a 1682 px stage and is scaled by KP (stage width / 1682) and the depth ratio.

// Mirroring: the mockup's enemy faces right; every x offset and rotation is multiplied by DIR.

// No backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && t !== caster);

if (!caster) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const tokens = { k: { token: caster, foot: cfg.casterFoot } };

const FOES = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; FOES.push(k); tokens[k] = { token: t, foot: cfg.partyFoot }; });

const CL = A.clips || {};

// cfg.live false = FULL TAKEOVER (the shot owns the board and drives S.cam: Apex Arrow's push-in); else LIVE board

const LIVE = cfg.live !== false;

const tl = oni.timeline(LIVE ? { tokens, clips: CL, images: A.images || {}, live: true, depthRef: 'k' } : { tokens, clips: CL, images: A.images || {} });

await tl.load();

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp, TOK = tl.TOK, feet = tl.feet;

const KP = (tl.STAGE.w || 1682) / 1682;

const R = tl.rng(cfg.seed || 2525);

const rnd = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * R();

const T = [], sfx = [];

const m = tl.mk(T);

const once = (at, fn) => { let did = false; T.push({ t0: at, t1: 1e9, fn: () => { if (!did) { did = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[ONI][twins] cue threw', e); } } } }); };

const S_ = (at, url, v) => { if (url) sfx.push({ at: Math.round(at), url, v: v * (cfg.volume == null ? 0.75 : cfg.volume) }); };

const SX = (at, key, v) => S_(at, (A.sfx || {})[key], v);

const DEG = Math.PI / 180;

const K = TOK.k, KF = feet(K);

// facing: toward the first target; with none (a self-cast) the way the caster's art faces

const DIR = FOES.length ? (TOK[FOES[0]].x >= K.x ? 1 : -1) : (K.dir || 1);

const DR = (pt) => tl.depthRatio(KF, pt); // size at pt vs the caster's spot

const HB = (k) => TOK[k].h * TOK[k].foot; // body height above the feet

const tFeet = (k) => feet(TOK[k]);

const tCenter = (k) => { const f = feet(TOK[k]); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - HB(k) * 0.5 }; };

// a spot in front of a target, on the caster's side (the mockup's front(t, gap))

const front = (k, gap) => { const f = tFeet(k); return { x: f.x - DIR * gap * KP * DR(f), y: f.y }; };

// EASE names as the mockup has them

const EZ = { lin: E.lin, quad: E.ioQ, out: E.outQ, in: E.inQ, outCubic: E.outC, sine: E.sine };

const EOUTBACK = (u) => { const c1 = 1.70158, c3 = c1 + 1; return 1 + c3 * Math.pow(u - 1, 3) + c1 * Math.pow(u - 1, 2); };

// ── the caster's body: keyframed channels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

// dx / dy (scene px), lift (scene px), rot (deg, the mockup's enemy sign), sx / sy, hop (an arc on top

// of the lift), pivot (0 = feet, 1 = the mockup's 50% 55% spin pivot).

const chan = (v0) => ({ v0, segs: [] });

const valAt = (c, t) => { let v = c.v0; for (const s of c.segs) { if (t < s.t0) break; const u = s.t1 > s.t0 ? Math.min(1, (t - s.t0) / (s.t1 - s.t0)) : 1; v = s.fn ? (t >= s.t1 ? s.fn(1) : s.fn(u)) : (t >= s.t1 ? s.to : lerp(s.from, s.to, s.ease(u))); } return v; };

const key = (c, at, ms, to, ease) => { const from = valAt(c, at); c.segs.push({ t0: at, t1: at + Math.max(0, ms), from, to, ease: ease || E.lin }); c.segs.sort((a, b) => a.t0 - b.t0); };

const keyFn = (c, at, ms, fn) => { c.segs.push({ t0: at, t1: at + Math.max(1, ms), fn }); c.segs.sort((a, b) => a.t0 - b.t0); };

const BODY = { dx: chan(0), dy: chan(0), lift: chan(0), hop: chan(0), rot: chan(0), sx: chan(1), sy: chan(1), pivot: chan(0) };

let BODY_END = 0;

// pose at t: what the engine draws, plus the un-pivoted lift (anchor points use that, as the mockup does)

function pose(t) {

const dx = valAt(BODY.dx, t), dy = valAt(BODY.dy, t), lift = valAt(BODY.lift, t) + valAt(BODY.hop, t);

const rot = valAt(BODY.rot, t) * DIR * DEG, sx = valAt(BODY.sx, t), sy = valAt(BODY.sy, t);

let air = lift, ddx = dx;

if (valAt(BODY.pivot, t) >= 0.5 && rot) { const r = (dx || dy) ? tl.depthRatio(KF, { x: KF.x + dx, y: KF.y + dy }) : 1; const ph = K.h * (K.foot - 0.55) * r * sy; ddx -= ph * Math.sin(rot); air += ph * (1 - Math.cos(rot)); }

return { dx: ddx, dy, air, rot, sx, sy, lift, bx: dx };

}

// moves (mockup: moveActor / goHome / lean / squash / liftTo / spin)

const moveTo = (at, ms, pt, ease, o) => { o = o || {}; key(BODY.dx, at, ms, pt.x - KF.x, ease || EZ.sine); key(BODY.dy, at, ms, pt.y - KF.y, ease || EZ.sine); if (o.hop) { const h = o.hop * KP; keyFn(BODY.hop, at, ms, (u) => Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * h); } if (o.trail) for (const f of [0.31, 0.62, 0.93]) ghostAt(at + ms * f, o.ghost || {}); return at + ms; };

const goHome = (at, ms, o) => moveTo(at, ms, KF, EZ.quad, o);

const lean = (at, ms, deg, ease) => { key(BODY.rot, at, ms, deg, ease || EZ.out); return at + ms; };

const squash = (at, ms, sx, sy, ease) => { key(BODY.sx, at, ms, sx, ease || EZ.out); key(BODY.sy, at, ms, sy, ease || EZ.out); return at + ms; };

const liftTo = (at, ms, h, ease) => { key(BODY.lift, at, ms, h * KP, ease || EZ.outCubic); return at + ms; };

o = o || {}; const inMs = o.slideIn || 650, hold = o.hold || 850, outMs = o.slideOut || 650; const end = inMs + hold + outMs;

g.save(); g.globalAlpha = 1; g.drawImage(img, x, g.H - h, w, h); g.restore(); } }); });

// Everyone on the board who is not the caster or a target, as extra timeline tokens

// ('b0', 'b1', ...), so the cast focus can fade them. Summon tokens already on the

// field are bystanders too (the user's dedupe rule: the parade never shows a real

const out = {}; const skip = new Set(); if (caster) skip.add(caster.id); for (const t of targets) skip.add(t.id); for (const t of (keep || [])) if (t) skip.add(t.id);

// Fade the bystanders out from 'at' over ms, keep them out until 'back', fade back over backMs.

const keys = Object.keys(TOK).filter((k) => k.charAt(0) === 'b' && /^b[0-9]+$/.test(k));

// The game's FULL_FLINCH (battler-pose.js): [time, scaleX, scaleY, shiftX px] and brightness.

actorEffects.find(e => String(e?.id ?? "") === BERSERK_EFFECT_ID) ?? null;

const berserkByName =

actorEffects.find(e => {

const n1 = String(e?.name ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

const n2 = String(e?.label ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

const wanted = BERSERK_EFFECT_NAME.toLowerCase();

// No backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const chan = (v0) => ({ v0, segs: [] });

const valAt = (c, t) => { let v = c.v0; for (const s of c.segs) { if (t < s.t0) break; const u = s.t1 > s.t0 ? Math.min(1, (t - s.t0) / (s.t1 - s.t0)) : 1; v = s.fn ? (t >= s.t1 ? s.fn(1) : s.fn(u)) : (t >= s.t1 ? s.to : lerp(s.from, s.to, s.ease(u))); } return v; };

const R0 = E0 + ER;

SX(R0, 'explosion2', 0.6); SX(R0, 'monster3', 0.45); squash(R0, 120, 1.08, 0.94); lean(R0, 120, -4);

S.world.push({ z: 4, draw: (g) => { drawCopy(g, G0, p, (1 - k) * fade); drawCopy(g, G1, p, k * fade); } }); });

const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][ZERO-TRIGGER:TWIN]";

/* =========================

CHANGE ONLY THESE 2 LINES

========================= */

// Jill:

// const TARGET_ACTOR_UUID = "Actor.cPdnhK7AEVQG5ohd";

// const TARGET_NAME = "Jill";

// Jack:

const TARGET_ACTOR_UUID = "Actor.8nncIhGQAEJ0ABjl";

const TARGET_NAME = "Jack";

/* =========================

MAIN LOGIC

========================= */

const p = __PAYLOAD ?? {};

p.meta = p.meta || {};

const hardCancel = (reason) => {

p.meta.__abortPipeline = true;

if (typeof context?.cancelPipeline === "function") {

return context.cancelPipeline(reason);

}

console.warn(TAG, reason);

return;

};

const norm = (v) => String(v ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

const resolveActorFromAny = async (value) => {

try {

if (!value) return null;

if (value?.actor) return value.actor;

if (value?.document?.actor) return value.document.actor;

if (typeof value === "string" && /^(Actor|Scene)\./.test(value)) {

const doc = await fromUuid(value);

return doc?.actor ?? doc ?? null;

}

if (typeof value?.uuid === "string" && /^(Actor|Scene)\./.test(value.uuid)) {

const doc = await fromUuid(value.uuid);

return doc?.actor ?? doc ?? null;

}

return null;

} catch (err) {

console.warn(TAG, "resolveActorFromAny failed", value, err);

return null;

}

};

// Resolve caster

const casterDoc = await fromUuid(

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attackerUuid ??

""

);

const caster = casterDoc?.actor ?? casterDoc ?? null;

if (!caster) {

return hardCancel(`${TAG} Missing caster.`);

}

// Read trigger payload

const phase =

p?.meta?.reaction_phase_payload ??

p?.reaction_phase_payload ??

{};

const phaseByTrigger =

p?.meta?.reaction_phase_payload_by_trigger ??

p?.reaction_phase_payload_by_trigger ??

{};

const triggerKey = String(

p?.meta?.passiveTriggerKey ??

p?.reaction_trigger_key ??

phase?.trigger ??

""

).trim();

const keyedTriggerPayload =

(triggerKey && phaseByTrigger?.[triggerKey])

? phaseByTrigger[triggerKey]

: null;

// Add explicit fallback for defeat trigger family

const triggerPayload =

keyedTriggerPayload ??

phaseByTrigger?.creature_defeated ??

phaseByTrigger?.creature_takes_damage ??

phase ??

{};

const triggerSource = String(

triggerPayload?.source ??

phase?.source ??

""

).trim();

const flattenRefs = (arr) => {

if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return [];

return arr.flatMap(v => Array.isArray(v) ? v : [v]).filter(v => v != null && v !== "");

};

// Try to locate the trigger creature

const triggerRefs = [

triggerPayload?.triggerCreatureUuid,

triggerPayload?.trigger_creature_uuid,

triggerPayload?.triggerCreature,

triggerPayload?.creatureUuid,

triggerPayload?.creature_uuid,

triggerPayload?.creature,

triggerPayload?.actorUuid,

triggerPayload?.actor_uuid,

triggerPayload?.actor,

triggerPayload?.targetUuid,

triggerPayload?.target_uuid,

triggerPayload?.target,

triggerPayload?.victimUuid,

triggerPayload?.victim_uuid,

triggerPayload?.victim,

triggerPayload?.tokenUuid,

triggerPayload?.token_uuid,

triggerPayload?.token,

...flattenRefs(triggerPayload?.targets),

...flattenRefs(triggerPayload?.targetUuids),

...flattenRefs(p?.originalTargetUUIDs),

...flattenRefs(p?.targets)

].filter(v => v != null && v !== "");

const resolvedTriggerActors = [];

for (const ref of triggerRefs) {

const actor = await resolveActorFromAny(ref);

if (actor) resolvedTriggerActors.push(actor);

}

const triggerNameCandidates = [

...resolvedTriggerActors.map(a => a?.name).filter(Boolean),

triggerPayload?.triggerCreatureName,

triggerPayload?.trigger_creature_name,

triggerPayload?.creatureName,

triggerPayload?.creature_name,

triggerPayload?.actorName,

triggerPayload?.actor_name,

triggerPayload?.targetName,

triggerPayload?.target_name,

triggerPayload?.victimName,

triggerPayload?.victim_name

].filter(Boolean);

// UUID first, then name fallback

const matchedByUuid =

resolvedTriggerActors.some(a => norm(a?.uuid) === norm(TARGET_ACTOR_UUID)) ||

triggerRefs.some(v => typeof v === "string" && norm(v) === norm(TARGET_ACTOR_UUID));

const matchedByName =

!matchedByUuid &&

triggerNameCandidates.some(name => norm(name) === norm(TARGET_NAME));

const matchedActor =

resolvedTriggerActors.find(a =>

norm(a?.uuid) === norm(TARGET_ACTOR_UUID) ||

norm(a?.name) === norm(TARGET_NAME)

) ?? null;

if (!matchedByUuid && !matchedByName) {

return hardCancel(`${TAG} Trigger creature did not match ${TARGET_NAME}.`);

}

// Determine trigger type

const tk = norm(triggerKey);

const sk = norm(triggerSource);

const hpAfterRaw = [

triggerPayload?.hpAfter,

triggerPayload?.afterHp,

triggerPayload?.newHp,

triggerPayload?.currentHpAfter,

triggerPayload?.remainingHp

].find(v => v != null);

const hpAfter = Number(hpAfterRaw ?? NaN);

// Defeat / reduced to 0 HP detection

const reducedToZero =

tk === "creature_defeated" ||

tk === "creature_reduced_to_0_hp" ||

tk === "creature_reduced_to_zero_hp" ||

tk.includes("defeat") ||

tk.includes("reduce") ||

tk.includes("reduced") ||

tk.includes("0 hp") ||

sk === "defeated_manual" ||

sk === "defeated" ||

sk === "reduced_to_0_hp" ||

sk === "reduced_to_zero_hp" ||

triggerPayload?.reducedToZero === true ||

triggerPayload?.isReducedToZero === true ||

triggerPayload?.defeated === true ||

triggerPayload?.isDefeated === true ||

(Number.isFinite(hpAfter) && hpAfter <= 0);

// Normal damage detection

const damageAmount = Number(

triggerPayload?.damage ??

triggerPayload?.damageAmount ??

triggerPayload?.hpLoss ??

triggerPayload?.hp_loss ??

0

) || 0;

const tookDamage =

!reducedToZero && (

tk === "creature_takes_damage" ||

tk === "creature_deals_damage" ||

tk.includes("damage") ||

tk.includes("hp_loss") ||

damageAmount > 0

);

// 0 HP trigger takes priority

let gain = 0;

if (reducedToZero) gain = 6;

else if (tookDamage) gain = 2;

else {

return hardCancel(`${TAG} Trigger type was not recognized.`);

}

// Clamp Zero Power

const before = Math.max(

0,

Number(caster?.system?.props?.zero_power_value ?? 0) || 0

);

const maxZero = Math.max(

0,

Number(caster?.system?.props?.max_zero ?? 0) || 0

);

const after = Math.min(maxZero, before + gain);

await caster.update({

"system.props.zero_power_value": String(after)

});

p.meta.zeroTriggerTwin = {

expectedTarget: TARGET_NAME,

matchedBy: matchedByUuid ? "uuid" : "name",

triggerKey,

triggerSource,

gain,

before,

after

};

console.log(TAG, "APPLIED", {

caster: caster?.name,

expectedTarget: TARGET_NAME,

matchedBy: matchedByUuid ? "uuid" : "name",

triggerKey,

triggerSource,

gain,

before,

after,

matchedActor: matchedActor?.name ?? triggerNameCandidates[0] ?? null

});

land(H, TK, { fx: 'hit_phys', s: 'slash1', vol: 0.4 }); SX(H, 'steal', 0.5);

const C = coinsTo(H, tCenter(TK), bodyAt(H), n, 520);

const G = lean(C, 120, 0); gateAt(G);

BODY_END = goHome(G + 150, 420, { hop: 22 });

total = BODY_END + 400;

} else {

// Cleaving Strike: steps up to the party, one wide sweep, a hit cue on each target as it passes

const order = FOES.slice().sort((a, b) => tFeet(a).y - tFeet(b).y);

const xs = order.map((k) => tFeet(k).x), near = DIR > 0 ? Math.min(...xs) : Math.max(...xs);

const fy = order.reduce((s, k) => s + tFeet(k).y, 0) / order.length;

const mid = { x: near - DIR * 92 * KP, y: fy - 47 * KP };

const cen = { x: order.reduce((s, k) => s + tCenter(k).x, 0) / order.length, y: order.reduce((s, k) => s + tCenter(k).y, 0) / order.length };

moveTo(0, 420, mid, EZ.quad, { trail: true });

const W = lean(420, 220, -16); SX(W, 'swingF', 0.6); lean(W, 140, 18);

clipAt('ggslash', W, cen, 2.4, { z: 44, add: true, rot: 80 * DEG * DIR, flip: DIR < 0, depth: false });

order.forEach((k, i) => land(W + 70 * (i + 1), k, { fx: 'slash_phys', s: i % 2 ? 'slash2' : 'slash1', vol: 0.35, noCue: true }));

// contact cues: one per planned strike in a Chain (spread over the sweep), else one per target

const nCue = (oni.strikes && oni.strikes.length) || order.length;

for (let i = 0; i < nCue; i++) hitCue(W + 70 * (Math.min(i, order.length - 1) + 1) + (i >= order.length ? 40 * (i - order.length + 1) : 0));

const G = W + 70 * order.length; gateAt(G);

lean(G + 350, 160, 0); BODY_END = goHome(G + 510, 460, { hop: 20 });

total = BODY_END + 500;

}

await runShot(total);

`;
